annotations.text:
The margin mark is the whole idea.

The capture syntax you already type (! ? *) becomes the mark in the gutter, set in the serif, and a note with no marker gets a mid dot. It replaces the uppercase chip entirely, so a row states its type once and carries no boxes. Clicking the mark is still how you tick something done.

Rules, not cards.

No white cards, no shadows, anywhere in the set. Sections are separated by hairlines at four weights, which is what makes it read as paper rather than as a dashboard.

The date is the title.

"August 18" in Newsreader at 52px, with a small italic "today" tag beside it. Past days read the same way, which is what makes the archive feel like a journal instead of a log.

Cost to port: mostly globals.css.

Tokens, rules and type swap cleanly. The two real code changes are the margin mark replacing the chip in ThoughtRow, and a Google Fonts link in layout.tsx.
